item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence on unemployment-specific management beyond broad IMF projections and macro tables.\nI did not find a clear sanctions-related episode in 2024 that materially informed this lens.\n“Honesty” is mostly inferential here: the best evidence is that IMF/World Bank language and government projections tracked reality reasonably well on inflation and reserves, but I did not find an independent audit of official claims against household-level outcomes.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Executive Board Completes Second and Final Review of the Stand-By Arrangement for Pakistan","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-04-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/04/29/pr24130-pakistan-imf-executive-board-completes-second-and-final-review-sba","summary":"Pakistan’s policy effort had supported stabilization, with a primary surplus ahead of target, inflation declining, and reserves up from about $4.5B to about $8B.
